segments.summary: Peppa Pig and her family are shown, and Peppa receives a purple gift box from her mother in their living room.

Inside their living room, Peppa's mother, wearing an orange dress, presents a purple gift box with pink stars to Peppa, who is wearing a red dress.
A close-up shot shows Peppa holding the purple gift box, looking at it with a surprised expression.
Peppa is holding the gift box, smiling happily. Her mother stands beside her, smiling and gesturing as if talking to her.

segments.summary: Peppa Pig presents a purple gift box to her little brother George in their playroom, and he reacts with surprise.

events.description: Peppa Pig, wearing a red dress, stands in her playroom holding a purple gift box with pink stars. Her brother George, in a blue shirt, sits on the floor playing with alphabet blocks and a green dinosaur toy.
Peppa looks down at the box with a slightly concerned or thoughtful expression, while George continues to play and smile.
Peppa turns and walks toward the corner of the room, placing the gift box on the floor. George is no longer visible in the frame.
Peppa turns back to face George, who is now standing in the doorway. She holds the box up and looks at him with a surprised expression, her mouth open.
Peppa smiles happily while holding the gift box, looking pleased with herself.
Peppa presents the box to George again, who now has a happy, smiling expression, indicating he is excited about the gift.

segments.summary: Peppa Pig is surprised to see her father, Daddy Pig, holding a magic wand and a gift box, and later, she and her little brother George present their own boxes to their mother, Mummy Pig.

global_summary: In this episode of Peppa Pig, Peppa receives a purple gift box from her mother, which she later presents to her little brother George, who is surprised. Peppa is also delighted to see her father, Daddy Pig, holding a magic wand and a gift box. The children then present their own gift boxes to their mother, Mummy Pig. Afterward, Peppa and George play musical instruments together before the whole family gathers in the living room to enjoy donuts, with the children initially playing a game before being joined by their parents.
